synopsis: VMC is identified as a Fraunhofer ITWM research project in Chapter 11 and as an off-road-relevant program in the glossary [f8694, f16078]. Chapter 11 specifically says Fraunhofer ITWM offers VMC real-data environments [f8821]. VMC is grouped with InVerS and RODOS in a portfolio covering construction-site digital twins, commercial vehicles and excavator loads, but the supplied facts do not assign each application to an individual project; the supporting institute pages are labeled as vendor evidence [f8694].

relations.note: Both identify VMC among Fraunhofer ITWM's research programs alongside InVerS and RODOS.
Specifies VMC's offering as real-data environments within the institute's research portfolio.
Adds a concrete VMC offering to the glossary's program listing.
